_purpose: Sourced data backing the waste-economy module. Covers manure rates, harvest-index/residue, bees exclusion, and compost capacity.

wheat.source: Frontiers in Plant Science 2025 field study (Xinjiang arid-region wheat)

tomato_lettuce_potato_basil.note: Harvest index does not translate directly to fleshy-fruit or leafy crops. These need dedicated per-crop research.

pig.source: Two sources: general average ~11 lb/day, ASABE-standard ~1.2-1.3 gal/day, Missouri Extension 0.15 cu ft/day

q4_compost_capacity.source: 3x3x3ft minimum (27 cu ft), hereafterfarms 4x4ft bins, finished-compost bulk density ~37 lb/cu ft
